clauses.label: sole paragraph
clauses.text:
By virtue of the authority vested in me as President of the United 
States, Executive Order No. 5221 of November 11, 1929, entitled 
“Limitation on non-official Employment of Officers or Employees of 
the American Government”, is hereby revoked.
